name: Client Stakeholder One-to-One
description: Capture stakeholder priorities, concerns, commitments, and a shareable recap.

sections.title: Priorities and Context
sections.instruction: Summarize the stakeholder's stated priorities, desired outcomes, and relevant context.

sections.title: Concerns and Questions
sections.instruction: List concerns, objections, questions, and unanswered items.

sections.title: Decisions and Mutual Commitments
sections.instruction: List decisions and commitments made by either party.

sections.title: Risks and Next Steps
sections.instruction: List risks, dependencies, owners, and next steps.

sections.title: Shareable Recap
sections.instruction: Draft a concise factual recap suitable to send to the stakeholder. Do not include inferred relationship sentiment.

sections.title: Internal Interpretation
sections.instruction: Separately list internal hypotheses or relationship signals, clearly labeled as interpretations rather than facts.
